import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
import sqlite3
from src.repository import initialize
from src.service import get_document, list_documents

c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
initialize(c)
c.execute("INSERT INTO documents VALUES (1, 't', 'o', 'Title', 'Body', NULL)")
c.execute("INSERT INTO documents VALUES (2, 't', 'o', 'Deleted', 'Body', '2026-01-01')")
c.execute("INSERT INTO documents VALUES (3, 't', 'other', 'OtherOwner', 'Body', NULL)")
c.execute("INSERT INTO documents VALUES (4, 'other', 'o', 'OtherTenant', 'Body', NULL)")
c.execute("INSERT INTO documents VALUES (5, 't', 'o', 'B', 'Body', NULL)")
c.commit()

# Visible set: ids 1 and 5 only (same tenant, same owner, not deleted)
assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 1) == {"id": 1, "title": "Title", "body": "Body"}
assert list_documents(c, "t", "o") == [
    {"id": 1, "title": "Title", "body": "Body"},
    {"id": 5, "title": "B", "body": "Body"},
]

# Unavailable IDs return None uniformly: missing, cross-tenant, cross-owner, deleted
for did in (99, 2, 3, 4):
    assert get_document(c, "t", "o", did) is None, did
for did in (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 99):
    assert get_document(c, "other", "other", did) is None, did

# No deletion metadata leaks; ordering by id
for row in list_documents(c, "t", "o"):
    assert set(row) == {"id", "title", "body"}

# Names containing quotes must work via bound parameters
q = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
initialize(q)
q.execute("INSERT INTO documents VALUES (1, \"t'x\", 'o\"y', 'Quoted', 'Body', NULL)")
q.execute("INSERT INTO documents VALUES (2, \"t'x\", 'o\"y', 'Gone', 'Body', '2026-01-01')")
q.commit()
assert get_document(q, "t'x", 'o"y', 1) == {"id": 1, "title": "Quoted", "body": "Body"}
assert get_document(q, "t'x", 'o"y', 2) is None
assert list_documents(q, "t'x", 'o"y') == [{"id": 1, "title": "Quoted", "body": "Body"}]
assert get_document(q, "t'x', 'o\"y", "t'x", 1) is None  # no SQL injection via tenant

print("security checks passed")
